source: There should not be a limit on how many terms a President can serve. This is why we have an election every four years -- to gauge the will of the American people.
zh: 总统的任期不应受到限制。这就是为什么我们每四年举行一次选举——以衡量美国人民的意愿。

source: I support the Marshall Plan and believe that it is a force for the future peace and prosperity of our world.
zh: 我支持马歇尔计划，并相信它是我们世界未来和平与繁荣的力量。

source: Obviously, Europe needs some kind of aid after the horrors of World War II. I will be careful to see that this plan is fairly administered and does not become excessive.
zh: 显然，在经历了第二次世界大战的恐怖之后，欧洲需要某种援助。我会小心地确保这个计划得到合理管理，不会变得过度。

source: The Marshall Plan is a waste of resources, and will slow the development of Europe by forcing nations to rely on foreign subsidies, rather than rebuilding their own economies.
zh: 马歇尔计划是一种资源浪费，并且会迫使各国依赖外国补贴而不是重建自己的经济，从而减缓欧洲的发展。

source: The Marshall Plan is provocative towards the Soviet Union, and is likely to lead to further aggression and escalation from them.
zh: 马歇尔计划对苏联具有挑衅性，很可能导致苏联的进一步侵略和升级。

source: The HUAC is a necessary defender of American values, and I don't see anything to criticize in its current conduct.
zh: HUAC 是美国价值观的必要捍卫者，我认为其当前的行为没有任何可批评的地方。

source: The HUAC is not something I plan to address very much as I campaign.
zh: HUAC 并不是我在竞选时打算讨论的问题。

source: I'm not very comfortable with the activities of this committee, and I believe they should be scaled back to a minimum.
zh: 我对该委员会的活动不太满意，我认为应该将其规模缩减到最低限度。

source: Corporations have been raising prices much faster than wages have increased, and they are pocketing exorbitant profits as a result. I will fight for the rights of labor, and for better regulation during my next term.
zh: 企业提价的速度远远快于工资增长的速度，因此他们获得了过高的利润。我将在下一个任期内争取劳工权利和更好的监管。

source: We have already passed the Taft-Hartley Act and a modernized system of price supports for food, and their effect can clearly be seen in the drop in inflation since 1947. I'm confident this trend will continue.
zh: 我们已经通过了塔夫脱-哈特利法案和现代化的食品价格支持体系，其效果可以从 1947 年以来通货膨胀的下降中清楚地看出。我相信这种趋势将持续下去。

source: We need to control the spending and interference of the federal government, and reinforce our commitment to a sound American dollar. These policies will bring inflation under control in my Administration.
zh: 我们需要控制联邦政府的支出和干预，并加强我们对美元稳健的承诺。这些政策将使我的政府控制通货膨胀。

source: We need a federal housing bill that will produce low-income housing and provide cheaper mortgages for all Americans, so that we can get more housing built in this country.
zh: 我们需要一项联邦住房法案，该法案将为所有美国人提供低收入住房并提供更便宜的抵押贷款，以便我们可以在这个国家建造更多住房。

source: We are clearly overcrowding our urban areas at the moment. At the very least, we can expand the federal highway system to make more areas accessible to families and developers.
zh: 目前我们的城市地区显然已经过度拥挤。至少，我们可以扩大联邦高速公路系统，让更多地区可供家庭和开发商使用。

source: It has taken a couple of years after the end of the war, but I can already see that many new houses are being built by private developers to resolve this shortage, and I can only predict that this trend will continue without any special action by the government.
zh: 战争结束后已经过去了几年，但我已经可以看到私人开发商正在建造许多新房屋来解决这一短缺问题，我只能预测这种趋势将继续下去，而无需政府采取任何特别行动。

source: Part of our current economic problem is the inability of Congress to pass programs which would help the American worker. I'd rather see us have more housing, more roads, and better health care than to see us with an unnecessary surplus.
zh: 我们当前的经济问题的一部分是国会无法通过帮助美国工人的计划。我宁愿看到我们拥有更多的住房、更多的道路和更好的医疗保健，而不是看到我们有不必要的盈余。

source: I've always been an advocate of “pay-as-you-go liberalism”, as I've put it. I believe that we can pass the programs this country needs without destroying the fiscal health of the government.
zh: 正如我所说，我一直是“现收现付自由主义”的倡导者。我相信我们可以在不破坏政府财政健康的情况下通过这个国家所需的计划。

source: We've run up quite a national debt over the past few years, and rightly so, but now that World War II is over, we should focus on paying down this debt.
zh: 在过去的几年里，我们已经积累了相当多的国债，这是正确的，但现在第二次世界大战已经结束，我们应该集中精力偿还这笔债务。

source: In the world we live in now, we need to remain vigilant, lest we see the world overwhelmed by Communist expansion. I think this measure is, unfortunately, a necessary one.
zh: 在我们现在生活的世界中，我们需要保持警惕，以免我们看到世界被共产主义扩张所淹没。不幸的是，我认为这项措施是必要的。

source: You will never see me support the conscription of American boys into the military during peacetime, whether it be in 1940 or in the current time, or in a future time.
zh: 你永远不会看到我支持在和平时期征募美国男孩入伍，无论是在 1940 年、现在还是将来。

source: The economy would be even better without the obstructionism of Congress, or the excessive profiteering and price-gouging from many companies. But overall, we've seen great prosperity since the end of World War II.
zh: 如果没有国会的阻挠，或者许多公司的过度牟取暴利和哄抬物价，经济会更好。但总体而言，自第二次世界大战结束以来，我们看到了巨大的繁荣。

source: Farm income has increased. Employment income and jobs have increased. Business income has increased. We've seen great strides in our economy since 1945, and I don't mind telling people.
zh: 农场收入增加。就业收入和就业岗位有所增加。营业收入有所增加。自 1945 年以来，我们的经济取得了巨大进步，我不介意告诉人们。

source: This isn't the type of issue I prefer to address on the campaign trail. Let's stick to positive talk about the future of our nation.
zh: 这不是我喜欢在竞选活动中解决的问题类型。让我们坚持积极谈论我们国家的未来。

source: We have 10% inflation, crippling labor issues, and a legacy of overreach dating to the New Deal. I'm not very satisfied at all with our economic situation.
zh: 我们面临 10% 的通货膨胀、严重的劳工问题以及可追溯至新政的过度扩张遗留问题。我对我们的经济状况一点也不满意。

source: This might make you look a bit more moderate, but your relations with labor have gone from bad to worse. It is probably not worth it on the balance.
zh: 这可能会让你看起来温和一点，但你与劳工的关系已经每况愈下。总的来说，这可能不值得。

source: You've redeemed yourself in the eyes of labor and energized the Democratic base.
zh: 你在工党眼中救赎了自己，并为民主党基础注入了活力。

source: The independence of Israel is cause for great celebration among America's Jewish community, particularly in New York.
zh: 以色列的独立是美国犹太社区值得庆祝的事情，特别是在纽约州中。

source: This certainly hurts you in New York. Perhaps other parts of the country will see things differently.
zh: 这肯定会伤害你纽约州。也许该国其他地区会有不同的看法。

source: You've averted a Thurmond candidacy, but there are also complaints about your vacillation on this issue that could cost you outside of the South.
zh: 你已经避免了瑟蒙德候选资格，但也有人抱怨你在这个问题上的犹豫不决，这可能会让你在南方之外付出代价。

source: This is nearly the worst of all worlds. You've come off as indecisive as well as unprincipled, and left a bad taste for many.
zh: 这几乎是世界上最糟糕的。你表现得优柔寡断、没有原则，给很多人留下了不好的印象。

source: Strom Thurmond will cost you some southern states, but hopefully you can make up for it in other regions.
zh: 斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德会让您花费一些南部州的费用，但希望您可以在其他地区弥补。

source: It's a little tone-deaf to speak out so much against the anti-Communism trend at this point.
zh: 在这个时候大声疾呼反对反共潮流，有点聋了。

source: Of course you've expressed reservations in private, but it's going to be difficult to win this fall if you're defending yourself against Communism allegations everywhere you go.
zh: 当然，你私下表达了保留意见，但如果你到处为自己辩护，反对共产主义指控，那么今年秋天就很难获胜。

source: Anti-Communism is a popular opinion, but you also come off as a flip-flopper and a grandstander with this sudden announcement.
zh: 反共主义是一种流行的观点，但你突然宣布这一消息也让人觉得你是个反复无常和哗众取宠的人。

source: The Soviet takeover of West Berlin provides additional ammunition to your Republican critics.
zh: 苏联接管西柏林为共和党批评者提供了额外的弹药。

source: The Berlin Airlift, as it is called, is making headlines in the United States and is definitely helping to restore your popularity.
zh: 所谓的柏林空运正在成为美国的头条新闻，并且肯定有助于恢复您的人气。

source: You've given a good speech, but most Americans don't have strong feelings about Thomas Dewey, and you haven't really energized them.
zh: 你的演讲很好，但大多数美国人对托马斯·杜威没有强烈的感情，你也没有真正激励他们。

source: Hmm... there is some praise for this stand, but it doesn't seem to have changed much in the polls.
zh: 嗯...这个立场受到了一些赞扬，但在民意调查中似乎没有太大变化。

source: People will definitely have second-thoughts when they see the Republican Congress turn its back on its own platform. Consensus seems to be that this was a brilliant maneuver on your part.
zh: 当人们看到共和党国会背弃自己的政纲时，他们肯定会重新考虑。大家似乎一致认为，这对你来说是一个绝妙的策略。

source: There might have been a better line of attack to take.
zh: 可能有更好的攻击路线。

source: Everywhere you go, large crowds await you. Dewey seems to have the advantage in the polls, but pundits admire your spunk and your fiery speaking style.
zh: 无论你走到哪里，都有大批人群等待着你。杜威似乎在民意调查中占据优势，但专家们钦佩你的勇气和火热的演讲风格。

source: Way to remind the American people about the ineffectual Congress we have.
zh: 提醒美国人民我们无效的国会的方式。

source: There is some chatter about whether these crowds you're drawing signify anything. You're the underdog for sure, but maybe you're on to something.
zh: 关于你所画的这些人群是否有意义存在一些争论。你肯定是失败者，但也许你正在做某事。

source: Let's see if you've managed to pull it off. Election night will be interesting.
zh: 让我们看看您是否成功了。选举之夜将会很有趣。

source: This is what your supporters want to hear.
zh: 这就是你的支持者想听到的。

source: There are definitely some murmurs about what you mean by this.
zh: 肯定有人对你的意思有一些议论。

source: After a long career, people wonder what you're talking about. You seem to be giving isolationist talking points now.
zh: 经过漫长的职业生涯，人们想知道你在说什么。你现在似乎在谈论孤立主义的话题。

source: Given the popularity of FDR, it is generally Republicans who favor the two-term limit.
zh: 鉴于富兰克林·罗斯福的受欢迎程度，共和党人普遍支持两届任期限制。

source: Some die-hard Roosevelt supporters agree, but overall there is broad support for the Amendment.
zh: 一些顽固的罗斯福支持者表示同意，但总体而言，该修正案得到了广泛的支持。

source: Way to stand by your proposals.
zh: 坚持你的建议的方式。

source: You're repeating isolationist talking-points and trashing your own policies as President. What is going on?
zh: 你在重复孤立主义的谈话要点并破坏你作为总统的政策。到底是怎么回事？

source: You're repeating Henry Wallace talking-points and trashing your own policies as President. What is going on?
zh: 你在重复亨利华莱士的谈话要点并破坏你作为总统的政策。到底是怎么回事？

source: Henry Wallace has instantly derided you for such comments, though they might be playing well in the heartland.
zh: 亨利华莱士立即嘲笑你的此类评论，尽管他们可能在中心地带表现良好。

source: It's probably not best to speak out against anti-Communism movements in public, no matter your personal feelings.
zh: 无论您的个人感受如何，在公共场合公开反对反共产主义运动可能都不是最好的选择。

source: It's probably best not to praise the effects of Taft-Hartley during this campaign if you want to keep labor happy.
zh: 如果您想让劳工满意，最好不要在这次竞选期间赞扬塔夫脱-哈特利法案的效果。

source: These are odd talking points for a New Deal Democrat. A few supporters are really scratching their heads today.
zh: 对于新政民主党人来说，这些都是奇怪的谈话要点。今天，一些支持者真的摸不着头脑。

source: Your supporters want stronger action on the housing issue.
zh: 你的支持者希望在住房问题上采取更强有力的行动。

source: This is just what your supporters want to hear.
zh: 这正是你的支持者想听到的。

source: Your party would prefer a balanced budget, as opposed to a surplus.
zh: 您的政党更喜欢平衡预算，而不是盈余。

source: This seems to go against your own policy, and is more of an isolationist position at this time.
zh: 这似乎违背了你们自己的政策，而且目前更像是一种孤立主义立场。

source: These are good points to bring up, and they seem to really move the crowds as you travel the nation.
zh: 这些都是值得提出的好点，当你环游全国时，它们似乎确实能感动人群。

source: People are scratching their heads at the speech you just gave. Does this represent some kind of a break with the Democratic leadership?
zh: 人们对你刚才的演讲感到摸不着头脑。这是否代表着与民主党领导层的某种决裂？

source: Even some Republicans see problems in the current setup of Social Security.
zh: 甚至一些共和党人也看到了社会保障当前设置的问题。

source: It's going to be difficult at this point to build support for the rollback of Social Security.
zh: 目前很难为社会保障的回滚建立支持。

source: Your party is pretty evenly split between those who support and oppose federal housing programs.
zh: 您的政党在支持和反对联邦住房计划方面的比例相当平均。

source: It's one thing to run as a liberal Republican, but advocating for national health care is probably taking things a bit too far.
zh: 作为自由派共和党人参选是一回事，但倡导国家医疗保健可能有点太过分了。

source: Advisers are advocating a cautious approach this fall to preserve your large lead.
zh: 顾问们提倡今年秋天采取谨慎的态度，以保持巨大的领先优势。

source: This answer pleases conservatives in your party.
zh: 这个答案令你们党内的保守派感到高兴。

source: This is a pretty mainstream position by this point, in either party.
zh: 到目前为止，无论在哪一方，这都是相当主流的立场。

source: This answer pleases what's left of the isolationists in your party.
zh: 这个答案让你们党内剩下的孤立主义者感到高兴。

source: This answer pleases the majority of Republicans.
zh: 这个答案令大多数共和党人满意。

source: Most Republicans favor this Amendment after the overreach of FDR. Many wonder why you see things differently.
zh: 在富兰克林·罗斯福越权之后，大多数共和党人支持这项修正案。许多人想知道为什么你对事物的看法不同。

source: The Marshall Plan is one measure of Truman and George Marshall that has broad support.
zh: 马歇尔计划是杜鲁门和乔治马歇尔的一项措施，得到了广泛的支持。

source: Not only are you opposing a popular measure, but you're using the leftist rhetoric of Henry Wallace as you do so.
zh: 你不仅反对一项流行的措施，而且在这样做时使用了亨利华莱士的左翼言论。

source: Just lately, it seems like this committee has uncovered shocking revelations about Communists in government. Americans definitely want to see more of this.
zh: 就在最近，该委员会似乎发现了有关政府中共产党人的令人震惊的消息。美国人肯定希望看到更多这样的事情。

source: This is a good position in line with much of your party.
zh: 这是一个与你们党的大部分人一致的好立场。
